Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. We're ready to finish vendor activation so we can issue the initial PO and schedule first invoices. To keep this quick, could you confirm and/or upload the following items by end of week?

- Signed W-9 (or W-8BEN-E if you are non-US)
- VAT registration certificate (if applicable)
- Legal entity name as you want it on the PO/invoice
- EIN / Tax ID (last 4 digits are fine in email; full EIN via secure portal)
- Remittance address for billing and receiving POs
- Primary AP contact (name, email, phone)
- Banking details for ACH (we also accept virtual card — please indicate preference)

You can reply here with attachments or upload to our secure intake: https://redwood-procure-drive.example.com/novacore (preferred for bank details).

Once Marissa verifies the tax docs and remittance info we'll issue PO-Redwood-0004827 and confirm the first billing cycle. If there's anything on our side you need (examples of invoice emails, PO format), let me know and I’ll loop in Ops.

Appreciate a quick confirmation.

Best,
Ben
